description: This file implements utility functions for QUIC protocol masque support, including version support, configuration, mode string conversion, and Linux-specific TUN interface creation.

classes.name: MasqueMode
classes.description: Enumeration representing different masque modes: invalid, open, and connect IP.

methods.name: MasqueSupportedVersions
methods.description: Returns a vector of supported QUIC versions supporting IETF draft, excluding QUICv2.

methods.name: MasqueEncapsulatedConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a QUIC configuration with max packet size set for encapsulated packets.

methods.name: MasqueModeToString
methods.description: Converts a MasqueMode enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const MasqueMode&)
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a MasqueMode to an output stream.

methods.name: CreateTunInterface
methods.description: Creates a Linux TUN interface with specified client address and server flag; returns file descriptor or -1 if unsupported or failed.
